records.text: Candace Owens was placed in an extraordinary learners program after a high test score and was offered an all-expenses place at a private school.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: got a very high score on this we'd like to put her in what was called the extraordinary learners program and after being in a couple of these classes they then said to my mom that we would like to pay for her to go all expenses to this academy King Lowe Haywood private school and my mom was like well you should go this is an amazing opportunity and then I started bursting out in tears crying being like mom please don't make me go I just we had just changed schools elementary schools

verification.notes: This is Owens's personal childhood recollection of testing, an 'extraordinary learners' program, and a private-school offer. No public contemporaneous record is available to corroborate the specific events.
